query:

  director = 'Various (showrunner: Scott Buck)',
  `cast` = 'Finn Jones as Danny Rand / Iron Fist, Jessica Henwick as Colleen Wing, Tom Pelphrey as Ward Meachum, Jessica Stroup as Joy Meachum, David Wenham as Harold Meachum, Rosario Dawson as Claire Temple, Ramon Rodriguez as Bakuto',
  tagline = 'The Immortal Iron Fist returns to New York. A flawed beginning that planted seeds for better stories.',
  description = 'Iron Fist Season 1 follows Danny Rand, who returns to New York City after being presumed dead for 15 years, to reclaim his family''s company and fight the criminal element corrupting it with his mystical kung fu power — the Iron Fist.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/iron-fist-s1-featured-4nmRJuFDiLzybfmeb39uoJ.webp',
  episodeCount = 13,
  seasonCount = 1,
  platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 19,
  rtAudienceScore = 75,
  verdict = 'miss',
  cardMarketContent = '## Iron Fist Cards: Budget Picks with Upside

Iron Fist cards are among the most affordable in the Marvel Netflix collecting space, making them excellent entry points for budget collectors. Despite the show''s mixed reception, the Iron Fist character has deep comic book history and the cards from **2018 Upper Deck Defenders** feature great artwork. Colleen Wing cards are particularly undervalued given Jessica Henwick''s rising star status.',
  keyCards = '- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Iron Fist Base** — Affordable Netflix hero card, $2-8
- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Colleen Wing** — Undervalued card of a fan-favorite character, $3-10
- **2017 Upper Deck Marvel Annual Iron Fist** — Early Netflix era appearance, $2-8
- **2019 Marvel Premier Iron Fist Sketch Card** — Original art at budget prices, $20-60',
  content = '## The Most Controversial Defender

Iron Fist Season 1 arrived with the weight of expectation — and largely buckled under it. Critics savaged the show for its pacing, fight choreography, and Finn Jones'' performance. Yet the show still found an audience, and more importantly, it introduced characters and storylines that would pay off beautifully in later seasons and The Defenders.

## Colleen Wing: The Real MVP

Jessica Henwick''s Colleen Wing emerged as the show''s breakout character. Her cage fighting scenes were the best action in the series, and her complex relationship with The Hand gave the show its most compelling storyline. Henwick would go on to become a fan-favorite across the Defenders shows.

## Redemption Arc

While Season 1 stumbled, it''s worth noting that Iron Fist Season 2 (with a new showrunner) was a massive improvement, and Danny Rand''s appearances in Luke Cage Season 2 showed what the character could be with better writing. The seeds planted here — the Meachum family drama, Colleen''s heritage — bore fruit later.

## Fun Facts

- Finn Jones had only 3 weeks to train for fight scenes due to scheduling
- Jessica Henwick did most of her own cage fighting choreography
- The show was originally developed as a feature film before becoming a series
- Tom Pelphrey''s Ward Meachum became a fan-favorite by season''s end
- The boardroom drama was inspired by the Iron Man comics of the 1980s',
  metaDescription = 'Iron Fist Season 1 (2017) complete guide — honest assessment, Colleen Wing spotlight, trading card market values, budget picks for collectors, and the redemption that followed.',
  keywords = 'iron fist, netflix marvel, finn jones, danny rand, colleen wing, jessica henwick, defenders, marvel cards, kung fu',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Iron Fist Defenders cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Iron Fist Season 1 worth watching?","answer":"While critically panned, Iron Fist Season 1 introduces important characters and plot threads for The Defenders and later seasons. Many fans recommend watching it for completeness, noting that Season 2 is significantly better."},{"question":"Why was Iron Fist so poorly received?","answer":"The main criticisms were slow pacing, underwhelming fight choreography (partly due to limited training time), and a protagonist who was less compelling than the supporting cast."},{"question":"Does Iron Fist improve after Season 1?","answer":"Yes, significantly. Iron Fist Season 2 with new showrunner M. Raven Metzner was much better received, and Danny Rand''s guest appearances in Luke Cage Season 2 were praised."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'iron-fist-season-1-2017'
